name: github-gateway
description: Cognito-authenticated proxy from Sveltia to GitHub via a GitHub App

scripts.build: esbuild index.mjs --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --external:@aws-sdk/* --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
